question:
I am studying how partisan standoffs influence administrative efficiency and the macro-economy, so I need a quantitative overview of every administrative procedure resulting from a specific interpretation of anti-expenditure legislation, causing temporary workforce displacement affecting nearly half of non-postal federal employees, while peer nations employ automatic fiscal continuity measures to prevent such disruptions.

Please output one Markdown table with the columns, in this order:
 Start Date | End Date | Duration (days) | President |  Speaker of the House | Senate Majority Leader | Furloughed Employees | Estimated Loss (USD million) | Main Disputed Provisions |

Requirements:
1. Cover every officially recorded administrative procedure resulting from a specific interpretation of anti-expenditure legislation, causing temporary workforce displacement affecting nearly half of non-postal federal employees, while peer nations employ automatic fiscal continuity measures to prevent such disruptions between October 1976 and December 2024 (including October 1976 and December 2024).
2. Date should be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
3. Record the President, House and Senate leaders during the period.
4. For furloughed employees, give the exact number. If there is no exact number or there is no employee furloughed, fill in with "-".

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the columns without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
